name: Kaliski binary-GCD inversion (Roetteler two-Kaliski affine point-add)
description: Baseline: affine point add with two reversible Kaliski binary-GCD modular inversions holding explicit Bezout (r,s) registers.
effect: baseline 10,758,874,395 (derived) = ~3.96M T x 2715 Q; inverse ~79% of Toffoli per f94f726
uses_measurement: partial: later 'fast Cuccaro' paths used HMR
notes: Named in f94f726/42d936f notes. Kaliski/dialog code absent from leader (grep). anupsv 1b4e026 tested a single batched inversion (c = dx^3*e) and found it net-negative (+256 peak).

name: (r,s) cswap boundary merge
description: Fuse step9(k) and step3(k+1) Bezout conditional swaps across Kaliski iterations via cswap(a)*cswap(b)=cswap(a xor b) with a frame-parity qubit.
effect: -274k Toffoli, peak-neutral; -6.92% vs running best
notes: Kaliski-era only.

name: (u,v_w) cswap boundary merge on equality-free prefix
description: Same cswap-fusion identity applied to the GCD operand pair for an early safe prefix of iterations where u != v_w (comparison correction gt ^= frame valid).
effect: -7.19% vs running best (T 3.64M->3.36M at 2310 Q)
notes: Safe-prefix length later extended (0a0a631: 254->255; d1d29eb 329->331) with reroll co-tuning.

name: Carry/scratch hosting on provably-|0> or idle wires
description: Borrow adder carry lanes and history bits from registers proven zero at that instant (future history bits, shrinking high bits of u/v/s/r, idle transcript/future-log slots) instead of dedicated ancilla.
effect: f94f726: -126k T (late carry recovery) and peak 2459->2333 (9n floor); 0620443 C*/dialog-fold: peak 2309->2025; 744b274 host-gated: 1698->1572 (with windowed apply); 53cab17/40e10ac: 1466->1446; 62c8115 composite scratch: ->1355
leader_file: mod.rs (I74_RESULT_TOP_LOAN / I76_SOURCE_TOP_LOAN), bridge.rs, leapfrog.rs room planner
notes: Merged family: late-iteration carry recovery, 9n carry-borrow, dialog history-fold into v_w high bits, C* carry-pool relocation (0620443), HOST_GATED/composite scratch, late uv-high borrow. Validity of 'provably zero' sometimes rests on the empirical W-TRUNC envelope (approximate).

name: Joint-pin peak analysis / peak-owner tracing and qubit-cap retuning
description: Treat the peak as a tie of several co-resident clusters, trace binders per phase, attack all together; later pin an explicit walk cap and retune cap vs reorder for the Q x T optimum.
leader_file: leapfrog.rs (HEO_PIN_PP_WALK_MAX_QUBITS=1234, LF_REORDER, C35 cap block)
notes: Methodology plus knobs; break-even quoted as ~640-723 Toffoli per qubit at ~1.24k Q (6e00c30, 21a0ba3). Majority packing / cap-1234 retiming by mochimodev (a362dca) credited in 076f110, not read.

name: Iteration / round-count trimming
description: Lower the fixed number of GCD iterations/rounds/ticks to the empirical convergence tail, co-tuned with the test island.

name: W-TRUNC empirical width-envelope truncation

description: Truncate the Kaliski STEP-3/9 (u,v_w) conditional swaps to the W-TRUNC width + margin instead of the invariant 2n-iter.

notes: cswaps were ~27% of Toffoli. Leapfrog's fixed alternating roles remove data-dependent swaps entirely.

name: Carry-tail / fold-window truncation for the sparse constant f=2^32+977
description: In +-c constant adders and pseudo-Mersenne folds, cut the carry/borrow ripple a window W above bit 32; propagation beyond has probability ~2^-W.
effect: -2.04% vs running best (037fd71); W 96->59 f751e0b -0.49%; DIRECT_CONST_DOUBLE routing 375fdff -3.32%; apply-phase double/halve trunc 66ad478 (-152,520 T)

name: Correction-free doubling for small r (R_SMALL threshold)
description: In early Kaliski iterations where r is provably/empirically small, replace mod_double(r) by a plain shift (no reduction).

notes: Pre-existing in the tree when first mentioned (R_SMALL_THRESHOLD=326); origin not read. Kaliski-era only.

name: Fiat-Shamir reroll / identity-tail nonce island selection
description: Append identity X;X pairs whose targets encode a nonce; this changes the SHAKE256 hash of the op stream and so re-draws the 9,024 test inputs without changing the circuit. Pick a nonce on which every shot passes.
effect: no direct T/Q change; enables every truncation. Nonce also moves avg executed T by ~10-15k band (b5fa90f, 7bb8713)
leader_file: mod.rs (TAIL_NONCE, apply_tail_nonce; 96-op tail)
notes: First seen as KAL_REROLL (0ae959c; Gajesh 2a05eae and 08573bd describe the 'island lottery'). Fixed-length 96-op tail with prefix-hash reuse introduced by stevenhao f026481 (2026-06-04); compact base-1024 tail by swadhin 6f8aba7. jtrose24 f1acd7f flags the integrity issue explicitly.

name: Classical prefilter + GPU nonce search pipeline
description: Bit-exact classical replay of the GCD/walk (and later phase-repair sites) on candidate nonces, GPU-parallel, with survivors confirmed by the trusted 9,024-shot evaluator.

name: Lambda budget economics and limiting contract
description: Model failing shots per 9,024 as Poisson lambda (classical + phase); minimise score subject to lambda being grindable; buy lambda back with exact cuts and spend it where Toffoli-per-lambda is highest.
effect: 02146ca measured head lambda_total=23.29, P(clean)=7.7e-11; 9dcbdb8 trade table (ROUNDS_MUL -6 vs -2: 10.6x hunt cost); contract caps lambda at 18, later 19.5

name: Measurement-based uncomputation (Gidney HMR + classically-controlled CZ)
